item.title: [LU-20704] build: o2ib auto-detection picks the wrong ofa_kernel tree
item.description:
With a recent DOCA-Host installed via deb packages, automatic o2ib detection (--with-o2ib=yes or omitted) picks the raw mlnx-ofed-kernel source tree instead of the built one, and configure then fails with "can't compile with OpenIB gen2 headers".

root@ubuntu2604:~# ll /usr/src/ | grep ofa_kernel
drwxr-xr-x  3 root root 4096 Sep  7 01:14 ofa_kernel/
lrwxrwxrwx  1 root root   29 Aug 19 11:23 ofa_kernel-2607.0.100@ -> mlnx-ofed-kernel-2607.0.100-1
drwxr-xr-x  3 root root 4096 Sep  7 01:14 ofa_kernel-dkms/ 

root@ubuntu2604:~e# dpkg --listfiles mlnx-ofed-kernel-dkms | grep ofa_kernel
/usr/src/mlnx-ofed-kernel-2607.0.100-1/ofed_scripts/mlnx-ofa_kernel.spec
/usr/src/ofa_kernel-2607.0.100

root@ubuntu2604:~# cd fs-lustre-release/
root@ubuntu2604:~/fs-lustre-release# ./autogen.sh && ./configure
...
checking whether to enable tunable backoff TCP support... yes
checking if Linux kernel has tunable backoff TCP support... no
checking if external o2iblnd needs to use Compat RDMA... yes
checking whether to use any OFED backport headers... no
checking whether to enable OpenIB gen2 support... no
configure: error: cannot compile with OpenIB gen2 headers

root@ubuntu2604:~/fs-lustre-release# grep -A 13 "OpenIB gen2 support" config.log
configure:24163: checking whether to enable OpenIB gen2 support
configure:24223: cp conftest.c kconftest.dir && make -d modules LDFLAGS= LD=ld -m elf_x86_64 CC=gcc LINUXINCLUDE= -include /usr/src/ofa_kernel-2607.0.100/include/linux/compat-2.6.h -I/usr/src/mlnx-ofed-kernel-2607.0.100-1/include -I/usr/src/mlnx-ofed-kernel-2607.0.100-1/include/uapi -I/lib/modules/7.0.0-31-generic/build/arch/x86/include -Iinclude -Iarch/x86/include/generated -I/lib/modules/7.0.0-31-generic/build/include -Iinclude2 -I/lib/modules/7.0.0-31-generic/build/include/uapi -Iinclude/generated -I/lib/modules/7.0.0-31-generic/build/arch/x86/include/uapi -Iarch/x86/include/generated/uapi -I/lib/modules/7.0.0-31-generic/build/include/uapi -Iinclude/generated/uapi -I/lib/modules/7.0.0-31-generic/build/arch/x86/include/generated -I/lib/modules/7.0.0-31-generic/build/arch/x86/include/generated/uapi -I/lib/modules/7.0.0-31-generic/build/include/generated -I/lib/modules/7.0.0-31-generic/build/include/generated/uapi -I/usr/src/linux-headers-7.0.0-31-generic/include -I/usr/src/linux-headers-7.0.0-31-generic/include/generated/uapi -I/usr/src/linux-headers-7.0.0-31-generic/arch/x86/include/generated -I/usr/src/linux-headers-7.0.0-31-generic/arch/x86/include/generated/uapi -include /lib/modules/7.0.0-31-generic/build/include/linux/kconfig.h KBUILD_EXTRA_SYMBOLS=  -o tmp_include_depends -o scripts -o include/config/MARKER -C /usr/src/linux-headers-7.0.0-31-generic EXTRA_CFLAGS=-Werror-implicit-function-declaration -g -I/root/fs-lustre-release/lnet/include -I/root/fs-lustre-release/lustre/include -I/root/fs-lustre-release/include -Wno-format-truncation -Wno-stringop-truncation -Wno-stringop-overflow -Wno-gnu M=/root/fs-lustre-release/kconftest.dir
